settings.headline: Fixed fees, quoted before we start
settings.subtitle: Every engagement has a written fee before work begins. Calls and emails during the engagement are included. Figures are fictional.

settings.headline: Fee guide
settings.intro: Starting points. The engagement letter has the exact fee.

rows.cells: Individual return, one state|$650|Fixed|Each extra state $150; rental $175 each
Business return (S corp or partnership)|$1,800|Fixed|Each extra state $250
Monthly bookkeeping and close|$450 a month|Monthly|Over 300 transactions a month
Payroll|$120 a month|Monthly|$6 per employee per month
Tax planning and estimates|$900 a year|Annual|Equity compensation, business sale
Notice response|$350|Per notice|Exams and appeals quoted separately
Estate or trust return|$1,500|Fixed|Each beneficiary over five $50

items.title: Questions during the year
items.text: A call or an email about your return or your books is part of the engagement.

items.title: A copy of everything
items.text: You get the full return, the workpaper summary and the letter, every year.

items.title: Moving your file
items.text: If you leave, we hand your files to the next firm without a fee.
